sandbachFocus: Sandbach United secured a dominant 4-2 victory over Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October, with goals from Foley, Birchall (twice), and Finney, maintaining their position atop the table with 22 points from 10 games despite a recent loss. Looking ahead, they face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, seeking to extend their title credentials against a struggling Nomads side currently languishing near the bottom of the division.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with Stafford Town (20 pts) holding steady after a 0-0 draw at Dawley Town on 3 October, while Wolverhampton Casuals (19 pts) impressed with a commanding 3-0 away win over Wednesfield Community. AFC Bridgnorth's comeback from 2-1 down to level 2-2 at Eccleshall keeps them in contention at 19 points. Allscott Heath delivered an outstanding performance away at Crewe, leading 3-1 at half-time after Eden Sears added a second-half goal, while struggling Shawbury United faced a difficult day at Barnton despite a 62nd-minute consolation, eventually losing 1-2 after a red card hampered their efforts. Bilston Town edged past Foley Meir 2-1 at home with penalties and conversions featuring prominently in a tense contest, New Mills maintained momentum with a 1-0 away victory at Market Drayton Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads took a narrow 1-0 lead into half-time against Telford Town, and Brereton Social drew 1-1 in an encounter that prompted post-match questions. Upcoming Saturday fixtures see all remaining First Division South sides in action, with Allscott Heath hosting Brereton Social, Alsager Town welcoming Sandbach's fierce opposition, Barnton facing Dawley Town, Bilston Town hosting Crewe, Market Drayton Town entertaining Widnes Town, Sandbach United taking on Cheadle Heath Nomads, Stafford Town visiting Wednesfield Community, and Telford Town meeting New Mills—all kicking off at 15:00 Saturday 10 October—while Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social travel to face Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
